decisions.decision: Accept all seven finding groups of the 2026-09-25 review into the project record as E2 measurements with a delegated reading, in a new docs/adr/0012 (title: 'The benchmark was weak by accident, and a regime-free chain wins at one year'), on one condition: no number from the review is quoted in docs/RESULTS.md or changes.json until committed code reproduces it. Concretely: (a) check whether the review's scratchpad (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jpmorgan-Projects-forecasting-the-future/e44164fe-7b10-4644-93dd-661c83983b55/scratchpad, files common.py, t1_benchmark.py, t2_baselines.py, t2b_vintage_start.py, t2c_paired.py, t3_durability.py, t5_discrimination.py, compute_report_numbers.py) still exists; if it does, commit those files unchanged under research/derivations/durability_review_2026_09_25/ with a README naming what each computed; (b) whether or not it survives, the src/ implementation of the matched-sample climatology and the condition chain (P1-2) must reproduce two acceptance numbers to within 0.001 before either is used: the default's one-year mean skill against the matched climatology = +0.1786, and the default-minus-chain one-year paired difference = -0.0582 with 90% [-0.0957, -0.0263]; a miss is investigated, never tuned away. Finding 6 (CPIAUCNS unrevised) is accepted as a three-vintage measurement only; its full-vintage check is part of P1-3's 0009. Finding 5's record errors are fixed under P1-10. The reading 'the model forecasts recessions: does not hold' is accepted as a delegated reading and written in ADR 0012 with the per-indicator table.
decisions.reason: Every number is a deterministic computation on committed baselines and the cache (E2), the adoption result survives every stress the review applied, and the review found no look-ahead. But its scripts were never committed, so today the findings rest on an artifact page, which the doctrine says to verify before building on. Reproduction inside src/ is required anyway for 0007, so the acceptance check costs nothing extra and converts the review from a page into code.
decisions.expects: The two acceptance numbers reproduce from src/ within 0.001, and the review's readings stand unchanged; the recession-indicator sign flip against the matched benchmark is confirmed.

decisions.decision: Register proving/experiments/0007-successor-evaluation-rule/experiment.json before any 0008 arm runs, with 0001 untouched. Contents, fixed now: (1) Two permanent reference forecasters computed for every backtest row and carried as columns in the forecasts frame, baselines/*.forecasts.parquet and `forecast baseline compare`, never as RunSettings fields (so the configuration hash and fit cache are unchanged): R1, the matched-sample climatology -- the existing expanding, publication-aware climatology (ADR 0009/0011 rules) restricted to outcomes whose forecast month is on or after the observation matrix's first month, derived from the panel, never a literal 1950-12; R2, the condition chain -- per indicator, a two-state Markov chain on the monthly condition with two rates (entry hazard, persistence) estimated by plain counts from condition-months published by the refit date and on or after the panel's first month, re-estimated at each refit, started from the last published condition at the forecast date, stepping the publication gap and then the horizon; point-in-time = P(state 1 at month h), any-time = 1 - survival. R2 must read conditions through the same publication-timing functions the model's rates use (including announcement dating). (2) Skill for all new claims is Brier skill against R1; the series-start climatology stays as a reported column for continuity. (3) The primary statistic stays mean-of-per-indicator skill (the paired machinery's statistic); pooled Brier skill (1 - sum BS_model / sum BS_R1 over all rows at the horizon) is reported beside it, and a claim is NOT ESTABLISHED at any horizon where the two disagree in sign. (4) 'Regimes help' is a paired one-year difference, method minus R2, moving-block bootstrap (12-month blocks, 10,000 resamples, seed 20260908): REGIMES HELP if the 90% interval is entirely above zero, REGIMES DO NOT HELP if entirely below, NOT SHOWN otherwise. (5) Ship rule per horizon for every re-ship after the one in P1-9: SHIP MODEL requires the skill gate (mean skill vs R1 > 0.02, 90% interval excludes zero), the P1-4 calibration test, robustness (3 of 4 chronological blocks positive vs R1), honesty (TV distance > 0.05), AND that R2 does not beat the method (method - R2 90% interval not entirely below zero); otherwise SHIP BASE RATE, where the base rate shipped is R1. R2 is a reference, never shipped directly; it can reach the submission only through a pre-registered arm (B1 at one regime, B3). Thresholds are 0001's, unchanged, because they were chosen from the problem's structure, not the data. (6) Deterministic audit at both cutoffs 2000-03-01 and 2022-03-01. (7) The P1-5 materiality floor. (8) Stated in advance: under this rule the current default is expected to read SHIP BASE RATE at one year, because R2 beat it by 0.0582 in the review; 0007's text must say it was written after those numbers were seen. Experiment 0008's arms are judged by the one-year paired difference against the current default with skill measured against R1 (primary), with the series-start benchmark reported as secondary for comparability with 0002. The pipeline's reported benchmark: `check-gates`, RESULTS.md and the register carry both R1 and the series-start climatology; 0001's five gates continue to be evaluated against the series-start climatology exactly as coded today, so its frozen verdict is neither recomputed under a new definition nor silently kept from a reader -- both verdicts are printed side by side, labelled.
decisions.reason: 0001 does not name the climatology's start; the archive's start dates chose it, and that accident flatters every skill number, most of all the recession indicators. A successor rule can adopt the fairer benchmark and the natural null without touching a frozen threshold. Making R1 and R2 columns rather than settings keeps every hash and cache key stable, which is what makes the acceptance check in P1-1 exact. The comparator for 0008 has to be fixed before the arms run, and registering 0008 under a benchmark 0007 retires the same day would be incoherent. Shipping R2 directly would be shipping a forecaster designed after seeing results; routing it through registered arms keeps the rule that nothing ships that was not pre-registered.
decisions.expects: 0007 registers before 0008's reference is captured; the default reads SHIP MODEL at one year under 0001 and SHIP BASE RATE under 0007 on the same run, and both are printed.

decisions.decision: Approve the slate with amendments, in this order. PREREQUISITES on main before anything is captured or run: (i) the 0007 columns R1 and R2 in src/ with the P1-1 acceptance check passed; (ii) scripts/research_arm.sh aborts the compare and paired steps when check-gates exits non-zero, and `forecast baseline compare` exits 2 when both sides carry the same configuration hash but the run's settings differ -- the trap 0005's RESULT recorded, which would print +0.0000 for an arm that failed its gates; (iii) `forecast audit-look-ahead --cutoff 2022-03-01` runnable as a second standing cutoff; (iv) a capture `baselines/head-2026-09-29` taken before (i)-(iii) and a paired comparison after, which must be exactly zero at every horizon, since references touch no forecast. Then capture `baselines/reference-0008` (the current default, hash fec79a040f9ca6f9, commit recorded) and register proving/experiments/0008-condition-aware-regime-forecasts/experiment.json: family of three, PROMISING at 90%, CONFIRMED_IN_SAMPLE at 96.67%, HARMFUL if any horizon's 90% interval lies entirely below -0.02, VOID unless the deterministic audit exits 0 at both 2000-03-01 and 2022-03-01 and one independent judged review is clean under the P1-5 floor, one run per arm, primary endpoint as fixed in P1-2. ARMS: CONTROL -- main unchanged through research_arm.sh; must reproduce reference-0008 with paired difference exactly 0 and interval [0,0] at every horizon, else the slate is void. B1 -- point-in-time questions only: compose through the joint (regime x condition) chain using rates.entry_hazard and rates.persistence exactly as the any-time path already estimates them, no new estimation, started from the last published condition, stepping the publication gap then the horizon; the any-time path is unchanged in this arm; required check: with one regime B1 reproduces R2 bit for bit (array equality, not a tolerance). Prediction: gains concentrate on unemployment-at-horizon and funds-rate-at-horizon; effect of order +0.03. B2 -- add the unemployment rate (UNRATE level, archival vintages, publication lag 36 days, expanding-window standardised like every other column) to the growth chain and the ten-year-minus-three-month term spread (both legs market data, lag 32 days) to the levels chain; state counts still chosen per chain from candidates 1..4 on the burn-in window, seed 20260908, shrinkage 10; the honest start must remain 1994-03 under the existing 240-observation vintage floor -- if any forecast date lacks a usable UNRATE vintage the arm is INCONCLUSIVE, never run on a fallback. Prediction: recession and unemployment indicators improve, inflation unchanged; sign of the mean not predicted; this is the arm most likely to return no verdict, and that is a finding. B3 -- p = 0.5*p_model + 0.5*p_R2 at every indicator and horizon, no fitted weight, model unchanged; a missing R2 value raises. Prediction: PROMISING at one year, ten-year difference positive. 0006 -- run it, with one amendment committed and dated before the run: its anchor becomes `baselines/main-single-chain-d14`, the single-chain six-state settings (hash ad7fcc1affd0746a) re-run on HEAD's code so that D14 (landed 2026-09-21, the day after 0006 registered) sits on both sides of d6; the reading rule, the +0.0295 threshold and the 90% level are unchanged; the pre-D14 comparison against baselines/main.json is reported as secondary. 0006 is its own family of one. CPIAUCNS -- NOT an arm of 0008 (it changes the sample, so it cannot be paired on the same dates); register it separately as 0009 after 0008 reports, with these rules fixed now: (a) a deterministic check that every cached CPIAUCNS archival vintage equals the current series on every overlapping month, any difference voids the change; (b) the inflation transform stays year-over-year so seasonality cancels; (c) the honest start is whatever the existing burn-in machinery returns; (d) the state count is chosen by the existing rule on the new window and the regimes-exist gate is applied as written -- if it fails for two chains on the 1971 window, the default stays at 1994-03 and that is the result; (e) read by 0001's gates and 0007's references on the extended sample, plus a paired comparison on the 1994-03 intersection that must show the model unchanged where the two overlap. REJECTED for now: coupling, time-varying transitions, another economy (briefing 05 finds the first two underpowered; the third is D8 and needs a registry before it is an experiment).
decisions.reason: Power: briefing 05 puts the detectable one-year difference at 0.018-0.050 (90%) and 0.023-0.064 at a family of three. B1 and B3 have plausible effects at or above their floors (the chain leads by 0.058 and its per-indicator gains are where B1 acts; a blend of two complementary forecasters usually beats the better one). B2's plausible effect is below its floor, but it is the only arm that tests 'observe what is forecast', a null there redirects the programme toward B1/B3 rather than richer regimes, and the harm guard bounds the downside; the cost of the third arm to the family-wise bar is 31% of z in the wrong direction only from two to three. 0006 is registered, cheap, and settles ADR 0010's open mechanism; its anchor moved underneath it by -0.007 and the registration itself says to rewrite the anchor before the run, not after. The harness zeros trap is the one thing that could make a failed B2 look like a passing control.
decisions.expects: Control passes (0.97); B3 PROMISING or better (0.55); B1 PROMISING (0.45); B2 no verdict (0.6) or HARMFUL (0.15); 0006 reads GRANULARITY, NOT STRUCTURE (0.7); 0009 finds CPIAUCNS unrevised on every vintage (0.8) but the two-chain regimes-exist gate on the 1971 window is a coin flip (0.5).

decisions.decision: Keep 0001's calibration gate exactly as written and report its one-year failure as uninformative, printing beside it the perfectly-calibrated null at the effective sample (median ECE 0.153, P(ECE < 0.10) = 0.09 at n = 31, from research/briefings/derivations/sim_calibration.py). For 0007 and every later registration, register a sample-size-aware calibration test: pooled over the ten indicators at a horizon, fit logit P(y = 1) = a + b*logit(p) by maximum likelihood on the resolved rows with p clipped to [0.005, 0.995]; 95% moving-block bootstrap intervals for a and b using the skill gate's own blocks, resamples and seed; CALIBRATED if the interval for b contains 1 and the interval for a contains 0 (two 95% intervals, joint size about 0.90). Before it is used, extend sim_calibration.py to show the test's size: a perfectly calibrated forecaster at n = 31 effective must pass at least 80% of the time; if it does not, the registration says so and uses the slope test alone at 95%, and the reason is recorded. ECE stays a reported diagnostic in both rules.
decisions.reason: A gate an oracle fails 91% of the time cannot evidence miscalibration, and the threshold cannot move. A two-parameter reliability test has ten times fewer degrees of freedom than ten bins and is the standard small-sample calibration check; the block bootstrap needed for it already exists. Checking the test's own size before adopting it is the deterministic check the doctrine asks for, and the fallback is fixed now so it cannot be chosen after the result.
decisions.expects: The slope/intercept test passes the size check at n = 31 and the current default passes it at one year while still failing 0001's ECE gate.

decisions.decision: Yes, every registration from 0007 onward states a class-based floor. Class A, future information: any path by which an observation labelled after the forecast date, or published after it, reaches a forecast -- VOID at any size, no floor. Class B, approximations main already carries: revised values of observations already published at the cutoff (D5-class) and registry-lag errors shared with the reference run (D14-class). For class B the reviewer must measure the corrected one-year paired difference; the arm is VOID unless the reviewer could measure it (no silent fallback), and it is RECORDED-NOT-VOID if the correction moves the one-year paired difference by less than 0.001 in absolute value and moves no verdict at any level or horizon, in which case the arm's reported number is the corrected one. A6 is not retroactively un-voided: 0002's rule was applied as written and its result stands; A6's design is re-runnable under 0007 as B3's cousin if anyone wants it, and its report must say it came after.
decisions.reason: A6 was voided for 0.0002 on a statistic whose smallest detectable value is 0.018; a rule that voids for any size makes every arm touching a benchmark or an outcome a near-certain VOID regardless of merit, which is what briefing 05 warned. The class split matters more than the number: a small leak of future information can be large on another sample, while a revision approximation the reference run shares is the same approximation on both sides. 0.001 is roughly 5% of the smallest detectable difference and ten times the harness's 1e-4 'anything a reader would act on', so it cannot decide a verdict by itself; the verdict-invariance clause covers the case where it could.
decisions.expects: B3's review finds only class-B paths, if any, below the floor, and B3 is scored rather than voided.

decisions.decision: Both sides are partly wrong; fix the imports where the direction is a real cycle and rewrite the table where it is merely narrower than the design. (1) Move src/economic_regime_forecasting/features/transforms.py to data/transforms.py and update its importers (data/audit.py:30, data/indicator_outcomes.py:31, data/panel.py:32, plus features/observation_matrix.py and anything in models). It imports only configuration.registry, numpy and pandas, so it belongs below data. (2) Declare `features -> data, configuration`: features/observation_matrix.py:31 importing PointInTimePanel is the true direction (a matrix is built from a panel), and with (1) the data->features edge is gone, so the layer-level cycle disappears rather than being declared. (3) evaluation/verdict.py:40 stops importing PROJECT_ROOT; the one use at line 49 takes the path from its caller in backtest or the command-line interface, so evaluation stays 'plain arrays; nothing above' as declared. (4) Declare `reporting -> evaluation, models, features, configuration`; reporting is the top layer and reading COLUMN_NAMES and the registry is what it is for. Resulting table in the package docstring: configuration -> (nothing); data -> configuration; features -> data, configuration; models -> features, configuration; backtest -> models, features, data, configuration; evaluation -> (plain arrays; nothing above); reporting -> evaluation, models, features, configuration. (5) Enforce: add tests/test_layer_table_is_enforced.py that runs `python3 scripts/layer_check.py --json` as a subprocess and asserts exit 0 and zero violations, and add the script to the 'lint and types' step of scripts/run_full_pipeline.sh and to the lint line in CLAUDE.md. (6) Correct the record: D16 and changes.json say layer_check exits 0 whatever it finds; it exits 1 on a violation today (run 2026-09-29: 7 violations, exit 1). What was missing is that nothing runs it. Measure the change with `forecast baseline compare` against baselines/head-2026-09-29: it must be 0 of 387 MOVED, and close D16 with the commit.
decisions.reason: data imports features and features imports data, so the table cannot be rewritten to describe the package as it is without ceasing to be a layering; one edge must move, and transforms is a leaf that belongs at the bottom. The other four are the table being narrower than the design, and widening it costs nothing. A check that is written but never run is K1; wiring it into the suite is K4, and 'if a rule can be a check, write the check'.
decisions.expects: layer_check reports zero violations, the suite enforces it, and the baseline comparison shows 0 of 387 fields moved.

decisions.decision: Fill anvil/2026-09-16--a4-two-chain-model/dossier.md adjudication as: decision = 'ADOPTED, PROVISIONALLY. The two-chain model stays the pipeline's default because the paired one-year gain over the single chain (+0.0590 pre-D14; +0.0519 on current code; +0.0650 against the matched benchmark) survives three seeds, blocks from 12 to 60 months, leave-one-era-out and the corrected benchmark. It is NOT adopted as a method that adds information over a regime-free forecaster: the 2026-09-25 review measured a two-rate condition chain beating it at one year by 0.0582 (98.33% [-0.1115, -0.0104]), and the pipeline's own one-regime composition is indistinguishable from it. The mechanism is presumed to be granularity, not timescale separation, until experiment 0006 says otherwise. Failure mode 3's early warning has already fired: within-state cross-block correlation is 0.51-0.67 of the kept dependence (briefing 05), so the displacement dissent is revived and recorded as a measured, separate defect that briefing 05 finds underpowered to repair. The out-of-sample test is the forward register (P1-8) with the falsifier's rule applied at 2027-07-01, 2028-07-01 and 2029-07-01: if the running paired 90% interval of two-chain minus single-chain still excludes zero on the positive side after three annual windows the adoption is provisionally supported; if it spans or sits below zero the in-sample gain is read as a selection artifact and the default reverts.'; classification = FACTUAL; by = 'claude-fable-5-1, delegated by Jeddy Xie'; on = 2026-09-29. Leave the outcome block empty until 2027-07-01.
decisions.reason: The dossier's strongest objection was that forward resolution is the only uncontaminated test, and nothing since has changed that; what has changed is that a cheaper test than the dossier knew about has been run (the condition chain) and the model lost it. The adoption rests on a measured paired difference, which is factual, and the correction to its scope is also a measurement, so the classification is FACTUAL, not TASTE.
decisions.expects: 0006 reads GRANULARITY (0.7); at 2027-07-01 the first ten correlated resolutions are uninformative either way, and the directional read waits for 2029.

decisions.decision: Register forward now, then monthly. Round 1, in the same commit as P1-9: the two-chain default (hash fec79a040f9ca6f9, via `forecast submit` then `forecast register`) and the single-chain configuration (settings of ad7fcc1affd0746a on current code, written by `forecast submit` to a destination that is not submission/, so no authorisation is consumed, then registered), both with the same data_as_of. Rows are already keyed by configuration hash, so no schema change is needed for round 1; the register's climatological_base_rate column already carries the series-start climatology. From the first monthly round after 0007's columns land (target: the 2026-11-01 round), add the condition chain R2 and the matched climatology R1 as rows, with an optional `forecaster` field on RegisteredForecast defaulting to the existing source values so old lines still parse. Do not register the direct logistic. Cadence: the first of every month, data_as_of = the latest month with every model input published; `forecast resolve` runs in the same step. Enforcement, since no scheduler exists: `forecast check-gates` and `forecast submit --verify-only` print a warning when the newest made_on is older than 45 days, and `forecast register --check` exits 1 in that case; the monthly step is documented in forecasts/README.md and RUNNING.md. The push of each round is the owner's.
decisions.reason: Every month not registered is holdout evidence lost for good, and forward data is the only test the dossier, the briefing and the review all agree on. Registering the single chain beside the default is what the adoption's falsifier requires; a later point-in-time re-run would be a backtest, not a record. The chain and R1 wait for src/ because nothing is registered from scratch scripts. A staleness check is the cheapest enforcement available where no CI exists.
decisions.expects: Round 1 is committed 2026-09-29 or the next working day; rounds for 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-01 follow with four forecasters; the register holds 30 + 60 + 120 + 120 rows by year end.

decisions.decision: Re-ship now, under 0001 exactly as the code computes it today, with the default fec79a040f9ca6f9: one-year rows from the model (0001: SHIP MODEL), five- and ten-year rows the series-start climatology (0001: SHIP BASE RATE). Mechanics, one commit: mint the single-use token with `python3 .claude/hooks/freeze_guard.py --thaw "delegated re-ship: the committed submission was produced by 9f95b12dba40d138, a configuration with two known look-ahead paths (ADR 0008); the default is the honest configuration" --subject submission/forecasts.csv --by "claude-fable-5-1 (delegated by Jeddy Xie, 2026-09-29)"`; run `forecast submit`; set CONFIGURATION_HASH_APPROVED_FOR_SHIPPING in src/economic_regime_forecasting/configuration/shipping_approval.py to fec79a040f9ca6f9; record it in ADR 0012. Disclosure shipped with it, in submission/ README text, docs/RESULTS.md and forecasts/README.md, verbatim in substance: 'One-year rows ship the model under the frozen 2026-09-08 rule. On 2026-09-25 a review measured a regime-free two-rate condition chain beating this model at one year on the same sample (-0.0582, 98.33% [-0.1115, -0.0104]); against a climatology restricted to the model's own sample its recession indicators score below zero. Both forecasters are registered forward beside this submission. The next re-ship is governed by rule 0007.' Do NOT defer: leaving the file at 9f95b12dba40d138 keeps a known look-ahead outward-facing for another six weeks. Expect a second re-ship in pass 2 under 0007, and say so in the ADR. Evidence that decides pass 2: 0007's per-horizon verdict on whichever method 0008 leaves as the default, with B1/B3 adopted only on CONFIRMED_IN_SAMPLE at 96.67% and a clean review.
decisions.reason: The current submission is the output of a configuration the project itself documents as leaking, which is a worse outward claim than an honest configuration that loses to a baseline nobody had scored. 0001 is frozen and its verdict for the default is SHIP MODEL at one year; re-shipping under it moves no threshold and requires no new code, so it cannot be blocked on the 0007 work. The review's 'do not ship as the model yet' is answered by the disclosure and by the forward register, not by keeping the leaky file. Shipping the chain or a blend now would be shipping an unregistered forecaster.
decisions.expects: The submission carries fec79a040f9ca6f9 with `submit --verify-only` clean by 2026-10-01; the owner endorses rather than reverses it; a second re-ship follows 0008.

decisions.decision: Seven further items. (1) The 2022-03-01 audit cutoff becomes a standing check: run at both cutoffs before every re-ship and every registration round, and required for VOID in 0007/0008 (already in P1-3); cost 30 minutes each. (2) Reopen D5 as a narrowed entry: it was closed on UNRATE and USREC while the conditions for output growth and both CPI indicators are read from final data by load_final_series; record the review's flip rates (output-growth condition 0.99% of condition-months, CPI above 3% 0.084%, CPI above 5% none) and schedule the as_of-threaded fix as a pipeline change AFTER 0008 reports (changing main mid-slate moves the reference), measured with `forecast baseline compare`; no verdict may be claimed from it. (3) Record corrections in the same docs commit as ADR 0012: the debt register's benchmark row says 'back to 1919' -- for recession dating it is 1854; ADR 0010's +0.0590 is a pre-D14 comparison and `baseline compare --against main` now reads +0.0519 -- label both; add the boundary caveat that 4x4 sits at the top of its 1..4 candidate range, the same caveat ADR 0008 made for six of 1..6, and do not widen the range (a third configuration change would confound 0006); fix D16's 'exits 0' (P1-6). (4) The month-by-month skill curve: approved as a registered measurement in research/experiments-drafts/ with the orchestrator's reading rule (carries skill at h when mean skill > 0.02 and the 90% moving-block lower bound > 0, blocks max(h, 12); ship-the-average horizon = first h after which that fails at every longer h), h = 1..120, descriptive, changes no 0001 verdict. Run it now for the default against the series-start climatology from the cached fits (the owner asked for it), and re-run with R1 and R2 as extra curves once P1-2 lands; the registration covers both runs and says so; label every h whose effective sample (378/h) is below 5.5 as uninformative rather than reading a crossing there. (5) Fix the harness zeros trap from 0005's RESULT before any 0008 arm runs (in P1-3's prerequisites). (6) Another economy: not now; D8 stays closed as scope and is reopened only by a registration after pass 2, for relative claims (two chains against the chain) where a revision leak is shared by both sides. (7) Write the decisions ledger entry in research/ledger/decisions.md for this pass, marked delegated, with the review dates above, so the counterfactual scoring the ledger asks for can happen.
decisions.reason: Each is a recording or a cheap deterministic check the review or the diagnostics already identified; the two that touch main (D5 fix, second cutoff as a gate) are sequenced so that nothing moves the reference run while a slate is open. The skill curve is the owner's own request and is descriptive, so it need not wait on 0007 for its first run.
decisions.expects: All corrections and the skill curve land by 2026-10-10; the 2022-03-01 audit passes on HEAD as the review measured (10,110 rows identical).

cautions: Do not push to origin. Every commit here stays local until Jeddy confirms; the register rows and the re-shipped submission are outward-facing claims and he may reverse them.

Do not edit proving/experiments/0001 or 0002. The 0006 amendment (anchor recapture on current code) must be committed and dated BEFORE the 2x3 arm runs; its threshold +0.0295 and its 90% level do not move.
Do not recapture baselines/main.json; briefing 05 and 0006 read it as a fixed anchor. Add new baselines under new names: head-2026-09-29, main-single-chain-d14, reference-0008.

Do not run any 0008 arm before 0007 is registered, the P1-1 acceptance numbers (+0.1786; -0.0582, 90% [-0.0957, -0.0263]) reproduce from src/, and reference-0008 is captured. A miss on the acceptance numbers is investigated, never adjusted for.

Do not quote the review's numbers in docs/RESULTS.md or changes.json until committed code reproduces them; ADR 0012 may cite the review page as the source of the finding but must say the scripts were uncommitted.

R1 and R2 must be columns, never RunSettings fields: a new field changes the configuration hash and the fit-cache key (D3 measured the cost at 33 refits per hash), and would make the acceptance check inexact.

R2 must read conditions through the same publication-timing functions the model's rates use, including ADR 0011's announcement dating; a chain that reads a condition one month early is a class-A leak and voids B1 and B3.
The matched climatology start is derived from the observation matrix's first month, not a literal 1950-12; 1994-03-01 is likewise never a literal in src/ and the same rule applies.

The harness prints +0.0000 at every horizon when an arm's gates fail and its cache never wrote its own hash (0005 RESULT). Fix research_arm.sh to abort compare and paired on a non-zero check-gates before running the control or B2, or a failed arm will look like a passing control.
0006's anchor moved underneath it: D14 landed 2026-09-21, the day after registration, and biases d6 by about -0.007 against STRUCTURE HELPS. Run it only on the recaptured same-code anchor.

The 0001 verdict for the default still says SHIP MODEL at one year and that is what ships now; the disclosure must state the review's finding plainly and must not soften 0001's verdict into the review's language or hide the review behind it.
